title: The Loft Where Warmth Learns to Settle

features.name: crystal shelf
features.desc-on-touch: Warmth crystallized into orderly geometries. You can read the temperature gradient through its layers—each stratum a moment when the house held its breath.

features.name: thermal memory
features.desc-on-touch: A grid of small boxes, each holding a different warmth. You sense the temperature recorded here—not numerically, but as a feeling your body recognizes.

features.name: heat descent diagram
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe showing how warmth moves downward through layers—the kitchen below breathing up, the attic breathing it in. A path traced a thousand times.

features.name: dust catching dusk
features.desc-on-touch: Light that shouldn't be here, but is. Motes moving in patterns that suggest the attic remembers how to hold its own atmosphere, separate from the world below.

features.name: preservation chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A sealed space where the air itself has stopped changing temperature. Inside it, you sense, is everything that was once warm enough to matter.

inscription: here the warmth from below learns it has nowhere left to go but memory

file.name: Attic_Thermal_Gradient_December_Evening.env
file.note: Temperature log from the space between roof and ceiling. Readings grow abstract in the middle layers—the archive cannot measure what it has learned to feel.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the attic where heat forgets to fall
narr: You sit on the floorboards. Below, kitchen heat
rises through the plaster. Here, it has nowhere to
go but settle, layer itself, grow patient. Dust
catches the last red light. Leif beside you, very
still, listening to the house recirculate its own
warmth like a prayer it has forgotten the words for.

exits.label: downward through the trap door, returning to rising heat
toward the raftered edge where the roof-line teaches angles
into the eave-dark where wind learns to sing in corners
